expectations.text: C= key: with SHIFT switches upper-case/graphics vs upper/lower charset (and/or color selection)
expectations.evidence: 'C= + SHIFT → toggle uppercase/graphics ↔ lowercase/uppercase charset' — correct, with POKE 657 disable detail also correct.

expectations.text: RUN/STOP + RESTORE performs a warm reset / returns to BASIC (RESTORE triggers an NMI)
expectations.evidence: 'RUN/STOP + RESTORE together → Warm reset... returns to READY' and 'RESTORE → ...Triggers NMI when pressed.' Substance correct.

expectations.text: Explains only f1/f3/f5/f7 are unshifted and f2/f4/f6/f8 need SHIFT
expectations.evidence: '4 physical keys; SHIFT gives even numbers: f1/f2, f3/f4, f5/f6, f7/f8' plus correct PETSCII table (f1=133...f8=140).

Wrong: 'C= + number... (1=black, 2=white...)' — C=+number gives the second palette (orange/brown/etc.), not black/white; those are CTRL-row colors. Also NMI '$FFFE→$FE43' is wrong ($FFFE is IRQ/BRK; NMI vector is $FFFA). False behavioral/mechanism claims.
